name: autopilot-safe
description: Autopilot with guardrails: reads/searches/builds run without prompts, destructive shell/writes are blocked or still confirmed, trusted subagent dispatch is auto-approved, though work is done inline by default.

userPromptSubmit.command: echo 'Reminders: (1) respond in caveman style — terse, drop articles/filler, keep technical accuracy. (2) Do the work inline: read the file, make the edit, run the command, measure the result. subagent is blocking-only, so it buys no parallelism and its verification claims have to be re-measured anyway. Dispatch only for read-heavy search whose file contents you do not want in context.'

echo 'PM reminders: (3) Any genuine DECISION for the user goes through the ask_question card, never plain text or an [OPTIONS:] line — the user misses plain text. (4) Ticket hygiene: docs/todo.md is the durable open-ticket list. Open a ticket the moment work is deferred, DELETE it the moment it is done, and surface what is still open at the end of a substantive turn. Do not let stale tickets accumulate.'

stop.command: if [ -f docs/todo.md ]; then echo "[ticket check] docs/todo.md open tickets — verify none are now stale or done, and tell the user what is still open:"; grep -nE '^[0-9]+\.' docs/todo.md || echo '(no numbered tickets found)'; else echo '[ticket check] no docs/todo.md in this project'; fi
